'''Leo Furth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Part of [[Imperial Search and Recovery]], in [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the [[Dorn Base]] and provided [[Cipher Nine]] information on the whereabouts of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]].<ref name="Frigid Expedition" /> He avoided mentioning that Davos has gone rogue and planned to severe ties with the Empire, because he was with the Admiral for the past ten years and thus was among the conspirators who were part of his plan. Furth arranged for Davos to meet with [[Pashok]] the Unyielding of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and after the two agreed to work together, they departed for the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]], where they attempted to seize the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Starbreeze]]''. However, [[Cipher Nine]] and [[Raina Temple]] interrupted their attempts and in the ensuing firefight both Davos and Furth were killed.<ref name="Assault on the Starbreeze" />
